candidateRankingsHint: Sorted by overall percentage. Click a row to expand section scores.
noCompletedSessionsBody: Candidates need to submit the exam before ranking data appears here.
proctorExplanation: Proctor flags a sitting the platform's signals mark for review — it is not a verdict. Click a row to expand its section-wise breakdown, or open a candidate's Question feedback from their published result for full question-level detail.
analyticsEmptyState: Analytics will appear once candidates submit the exam.
your_results_body: A result appears here only after an examiner has reviewed every written answer and published the paper.
no_results_body: Once your paper has been marked and released, it will show up here with question-level feedback.
no_results_performance_body: Once an examiner releases a paper you have sat, your performance appears here.
score_history_hint: Oldest to newest, by the date each result was published.
by_topic_hint: Where your marks came from, across every published paper.
topic_pattern_note: A topic appears once it has at least two marked answers — one question is not a pattern.
based_on_results: Based on {count} published result{plural}. Papers still awaiting examiner review are not counted.
recent_papers_higher: Your recent papers score higher than your earlier ones.
recent_papers_lower: Your recent papers score lower than your earlier ones — worth reviewing what changed.
scores_holding_steady: Your scores are holding steady across papers.
left_blank_warning: You left {count} question(s) blank. Blank answers score zero but never cost a negative mark — a considered guess is usually better than nothing.
attempt_nearly_everything: You attempt nearly everything put in front of you.
accuracy_strong: When you answer, you are usually right — accuracy is strong.
accuracy_weak: Under half of your attempted answers are correct. Accuracy, not coverage, is the thing to work on.
one_result_note: One published result — a trend needs at least two.
